faqs.question: What Shell Rimula grade is recommended for heavy-duty trucks in Oman?
faqs.answer: For most heavy-duty diesel trucks operating in Oman's high-temperature climate, Shell Rimula R4 X SAE 15W-40 is the standard recommendation — it meets API CI-4/SL and ACEA E7 and is suitable for most modern Euro III–IV engines operating at ambient temperatures above 15°C year-round. For newer Euro V/VI engines or trucks with diesel particulate filters (DPF), Shell Rimula R6 M SAE 10W-40 (API CJ-4/SM, ACEA E9) is required. For extreme Oman summer conditions above 45°C ambient, the 15W-40 viscosity provides better high-temperature film protection than 10W-30.

faqs.question: What is Mobil Delvac and which grade should I use for heavy trucks in Oman?
faqs.answer: Mobil Delvac is ExxonMobil's heavy-duty diesel engine oil range for trucks, buses, and off-road construction equipment. For most diesel trucks operating in Oman — including Volvo, Mercedes-Benz, Scania, and MAN trucks used by PDO and construction contractors — Mobil Delvac MX 15W-40 (API CI-4 Plus, ACEA E7) is the standard recommendation. For newer Euro V/VI engines requiring low-SAPS oil for DPF compatibility, Mobil Delvac 1 ESP 5W-40 (API CJ-4, ACEA E4/E9) is the correct grade. Always cross-reference with the truck manufacturer's OEM specification before selecting a grade.

faqs.question: What Mobil hydraulic oil is best for industrial systems in Oman's heat?
faqs.answer: For most industrial hydraulic systems in Oman's high-temperature climate, Mobil DTE 25 (ISO VG 46) is the standard choice for indoor systems, while Mobil DTE 26 (ISO VG 68) is recommended for outdoor hydraulic systems operating above 40°C ambient. Mobil DTE 25 meets DIN 51524 HLP, Denison HF-0/HF-2, Vickers M-2950-S, and Bosch Rexroth specifications — covering the majority of industrial hydraulic equipment found in Oman's manufacturing, construction, and petrochemical facilities. For extreme-condition applications or where mineral oil is insufficient, Mobil SHC 526 (ISO VG 32 PAO synthetic) provides superior thermal stability above 90°C operating temperature.
